verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's core function is producing AI insights and suggestions from a team's own code and PR data inside the product. The docs cover AI summaries and walkthroughs, findings with merge-readiness judgments, AI-ranked triage, chat over a change, CI-failure fix suggestions, and Slack-agent investigation that cross-references Sentry and Jira. Hands-on users corroborate useful, actionable reviews, though one team reports verbosity and false positives. Missing for 10: no evidence that the analytics dashboard produces AI-generated insights (it is described as metrics only), and mixed independent reports on suggestion quality.
